name: Common Room Booking Platform
description: Official hosted, read-only MCP server for Common Room Booking Platform (common-room.hk), a Hong Kong venue booking site operated by MT Technology Group Limited. Find verified hourly hotels, party rooms, event venues, restaurants with private rooms and boats; compare prices and capacity; and check hourly hotel availability. Users book and pay on the Common Room website. No login needed.
author: MT Technology Group Limited (common-room.hk, Hong Kong)
